chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abd Allah al-Basri, who said:
I asked him about a woman who died while with men. He said: She should be wrapped and buried, and she is not to be given ghusl (ritual washing).

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman; the deceased female mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: she is buried; indicating burial proceeds
key_terms.تُغَسَّلُ: she is given ghusl (ritual washing); here negated in the ruling
key_terms.تُلَفُّ: she is wrapped; meaning she is covered or shrouded
key_terms.رِجَالٍ: men; referring to the men present with her
key_terms.مَاتَتْ: died; indicating the case under discussion concerns death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman dies while only unrelated men are present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling for the case of a woman who dies while only unrelated men are present. It states that she should be shrouded and buried without ghusl (ritual washing), reflecting the legal limits governing contact with the deceased in such circumstances.
